gloss: twists and turns; complications; ups and downs

definitions.explanation: A complicated process with many changes, setbacks, and difficulties along the way.

examples.japanese: {紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}を{経|へ}てようやく{完成|かんせい}した。
examples.english: After many twists and turns, it was finally completed.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}らの{関係|かんけい}には{紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}があった。
examples.english: Their relationship had its ups and downs.

examples.japanese: {紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}の{末|すえ}、{契約|けいやく}が{成立|せいりつ}した。
examples.english: After many complications, the contract was finalized.

examples.japanese: {紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}はあったが、{最終的|さいしゅうてき}にはうまくいった。
examples.english: There were twists and turns, but in the end things worked out.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}を{立|た}ち{上|あ}げるまでに、さまざまな{紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}を{経験|けいけん}した。
examples.english: I went through various twists and turns before starting the company.

notes:
WORD FORMATION (YOJIJUKUGO):
{紆余|うよ} (winding) + {曲折|きょくせつ} (bends and turns)
→ winding and bending = twists and turns

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
・{紆|う} - winding, meandering
・{余|よ} - surplus, extra
・{曲|きょく} - bend, curve
・{折|せつ} - break, fold

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}を{経|へ}て - after many twists and turns
・{紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}の{末|すえ} - after various complications
・{紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}がある - to have complications

NUANCE:
Emphasizes that the journey to achieve something was not straightforward. Often used when finally achieving a goal after many setbacks.
